provider.title: Map provider
provider.description: Choose Google Maps, Bing Maps, or both.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: One search term per line, such as dentists in Delhi or coffee shops near Times Square, New York.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum listings to collect for each query and provider.

scrapeDetails.title: Open each Google listing for full details
scrapeDetails.description: Open Google listings to collect richer details. Slower but more complete.

language.title: Language / locale
language.description: Language code such as en, hi, or es.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxies may be useful for map sites that rate-limit automated traffic.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of browser pages running in parallel.
